name: Writing Keytar
body:
Price 10,000 gp; Slot none; CL 5th; Weight 3 lbs.; Aura faint transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This bizarre cross between a keyboard and a guitar can be played by anyone who has ranks in either of the associated Perform skills (keyboard or string). It allows its wielder to send written messages while playing a melody. The player may decide to have the keytar write the words he speaks or sings while playing, the words he thinks, or that each note or chord corresponds to a specific letter, syllable, or word. When the message is complete, a small colored leaflet comes out from the instrument’s bottom end and is instantaneously teleported to the desired recipient within a range of 100 miles.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 5,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells message, scrivener’s chant
